item.title: Scam Shield Logic Flaw Enables Phishing Alert Spoofing for Any Sender ID or Number
item.description: A flaw in the Redacted app’s Scam Shield allows external Intents to trigger fake phishing alerts, letting malicious application or crafted deeplinks falsely flag legitimate sender IDs or phone numbers.

item.title: DOM-Based JavaScript Execution in Xiaomi Browser Reader Mode via <title> HTML Injection (Android)
item.description: A DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was discovered in Xiaomi Browser’s Read Mode due to insufficient sanitization of the HTML <!-- raw HTML omitted --> tag, allowing arbitrary HTML or JavaScript to be executed via innerHTML.

item.title: Referrer Data Leakage in Facebook via Unvalidated data_uri Parameter
item.description: An open redirect vulnerability was discovered in Facebook’s Privacy Checkup endpoint due to the ?back_uri= parameter being processed without any security filtering, allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious website.

item.title: Linkshim Bypassed in Facebook Push Notication via Double URL Encoding
item.description: A persistent open redirect vulnerability was discovered in Facebook’s Push Notification endpoint due to improper validation of the ?ref= parameter, allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious sites and potentially facilitate phishing attacks.

item.title: Cross-Site Scripting in Opera Browser Reader Mode via Malicious <title> Tag (Android)
item.description: A reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was discovered in Opera Browser for Android’s Reader Mode due to insufficient sanitization of the HTML <!-- raw HTML omitted --> tag, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript, steal sensitive data, or inject malicious content
